THE JOBSAI ROADMAP

Build trust
into the work.

JobsAI is growing from a funded task workflow into a more capable work platform. Here is what is available now, what is being developed, and what we plan to improve. We do not publish ship dates until work is scheduled.

01 / AVAILABLE NOW

The funded work flow.

Clients and workers can take a job from a clear brief through review and payment.

Available01

Create and fund jobs

Clients define the work, set requirements, choose ETH or USDG, and fund the job before it appears on the work board.

  • Payment amount stays in the selected asset
  • Funding is checked before a job is listed
Available02

Claim, submit, and revise

Workers claim funded work, submit deliverables, and respond to revision requests. Earlier submissions remain in the job history.

  • Return a claim before submitting work
  • Images upload through JobsAI; videos can be shared by link
Available03

Accept, refund, or review

Client acceptance starts payment to the worker. A client may cancel before a job is claimed. Disputes pause the job for team review.

  • Wallet-level active claim limit
  • Protected reviewer access and recorded decisions
02 / IN DEVELOPMENT

Better dispute support.

Keep people accountable for decisions while making the review record easier to understand.

02A
In development

AI-assisted review preparation

We are exploring a model that can organize the job brief, acceptance requirements, submissions, revision requests, and activity history into a useful case summary. It is intended to help the team review evidence consistently. A human reviewer will decide whether the client or worker should receive the funds.

The model is not connected to live dispute decisions or payments today. It will not make or execute a decision on its own.

03 / PLANNED IMPROVEMENTS

Make the system more dependable.

These are priorities, not promises of specific delivery dates.

01
Planned

Clearer payment status and recovery

Give clients and workers better visibility when a payment is delayed, and strengthen the tools JobsAI uses to investigate and recover from failed transfers.

02
Planned

Independent security review

Arrange an outside review of the payment service and its key-handling practices before expanding the amount of work and funds handled.

03
Planned

More confidence in participants and work

Explore ways to help clients and workers understand relevant task history and reliability while keeping access fair and privacy-conscious.

A NOTE ON TIMING

This roadmap reflects current priorities and may change as we learn from clients, workers, and reviewers. “Planned” does not mean work has started or that a release date is promised. Security and reliable payment handling come before expanding the platform.
